description: This file provides a shell-based API for managing services using procd, including functions for opening/closing services and instances, setting parameters, controlling service state, and handling triggers and validation. It also interacts with ubus and json for inter-process communication and configuration management.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service with optional script.

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Sends the command message for the service.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Adds an instance to the current service.

methods.name: procd_close_instance
methods.description: Completes the current instance being prepared.

methods.name: procd_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter of a specific type for a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_append_param
methods.description: Appends a parameter to an existing parameter set.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a service/instance is currently running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a service or all instances.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Gets the current status of a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_open_data
methods.description: Opens a data object for a service.

methods.name: procd_set_config_changed
methods.description: Notifies that configuration has changed for a package.

methods.name: uci_load_validate
methods.description: Loads and validates UCI data, optionally calling a callback.
